name: Classic Margarita
description: A tart, citrusy tequila cocktail with a salted rim.

steps.tip: Use a lime wedge to wet the rim first.

steps.action: Combine tequila, lime juice, and triple sec in a shaker with ice.

steps.tip: Shake until the outside of the shaker feels cold.

steps.action: Strain into the prepared glass over fresh ice.

name: Moscow Mule
description: A refreshing vodka cocktail with ginger beer and lime.

steps.action: Fill a copper mug with ice.
Pour in vodka and lime juice.
Top with ginger beer and stir gently.
Garnish with a mint sprig and lime wedge.
steps.tip: Slap the mint before placing to release aroma.
